info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Operations Retrieval API provides developers with access to detailed information regarding market operations specifically related to hedge fund administration. By utilizing the unique parameter {param1}, users can retrieve data pertinent to a specific market operation, facilitating analysis and decision-making. This API is ideal for financial analysts, investment managers, and other stakeholders looking to monitor and evaluate hedge fund activities efficiently. It enables streamlined access to critical operational data essential for strategic planning and operational oversight.

get.summary: Retrieve hedge fund administration details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about a specific hedge fund administration resource identified by its unique ID. It provides comprehensive information necessary for understanding the operations associated with the specified hedge fund.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to hedge fund administration operations for the specified resource. It should include the necessary parameters required by the schema to ensure appropriate data retrieval.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested resource.
